programme.title: A Maid From Heaven
programme.desc: This epic depicts the romance between the Jade Emperor's seventh daughter and a young village man. When Heaven and Earth meet, can a common ground be found?

programme.title: The Delightful Forest
programme.desc: A grateful convict becomes his prison officer's defender after he learns that the officer's restaurant has been taken over by a local thug.

programme.title: A Place to Call Home
programme.desc: A young woman's life turns tragic after she discovers that she's adopted and then goes in search of her real mother.

programme.title: The Twin Swords
programme.desc: Martial arts star Jimmy Wang Yu plays Kwei Wu, who unites with his wife Kan to battle kidnappers at the Red Lotus Temple.

programme.title: The Bride Napping
programme.desc: Betty Loh, Grace Ting and Diana Chang star in this romantic comedy between a gifted scholar and the administrative official's daughter he falls for at first sight.

programme.title: Na Cha and the Seven Devils
programme.desc: Little Na Cha accidentally drops 7 magical peaches onto earth, which transformed 7 animals into devils. Na Cha must hunt them all down or his father will be punished by the King of Heaven.

programme.title: Boxer Rebellion
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager's use of the Boxers to remove the foreign powers from China yields unexpected results. Starring Alexander Fu.

programme.title: Flying Guillotine 2
programme.desc: The Emperor develops a more deadly Flying Guillotine and trains a squad of women to combat the 'Iron Umbrella' and a band of rebels.

programme.title: Shaolin Temple
programme.desc: Chang Cheh presents his epic vision of the Temple, featuring his favourite leads Ti Lung, David Chiang and Alexander Fu Sheng.

programme.title: Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: A kind Emperor lands himself in big trouble when he begins frequenting the gambling dens to learn what makes his subjects tick. Stars Anthony Lau, Wong Yue.

programme.title: The Trail of the Broken Blade
programme.desc: Wang Yu heads this film's stellar cast under martial arts master, Chang Cheh. Together, they present beautifully choreographed action scenes.

programme.title: The Adventures of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Based on the folk legend, director Li Han Hsiang presents this humorous portrayal of the Emperor Chien Lung's adventures in Jiang Nan.

programme.title: The Web of Death
programme.desc: A traitorous clansman bids to locate and then unleash the deadly 'Five Venom Spider' against those who bid to stand in his way.

programme.title: Hong Kong Nocturne
programme.desc: Three sisters (the quietest and most filial of whom is played by Cheng Pei Pei) attempt to sing and dance their way to happiness.

programme.title: The Long Chase
programme.desc: The chase may be long, but the action is fast and furious, in this tale of a dart master-for-hire and the innkeeper's daughter who loves him.

programme.title: The Merry Wife
programme.desc: Jealousy threatens to expose the secret relationship of a 17-year-old student and her 35-year-old teacher husband.

programme.title: Crazy Nuts of Kung Fu

programme.title: The Enchanting Ghost

programme.title: My Young Auntie

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran S2 Ep24
programme.desc: Captain Chloe's adventures through space inspire JoJo and Gran Gran, who make a visit to the space centre to see the planets.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran S2 Ep35
programme.desc: Great Gran Gran shows JoJo her St Lucian local newsletter, and they are inspired to make their own community newsletter to tell everyone in the local area what's going on.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran S2 Ep37
programme.desc: JoJo and Gran Gran discover Ezra's having a Tyrannosaurus Tea Party at the Museum! But, when Ezra doesn't have time to make his special strawberry cake, Gran Gran has a plan to help!

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran S3 Ep2
programme.desc: At the community jam, everyone makes music together. Gran Gran gives JoJo a shaker to join in with the band, but with Charlene stuck in traffic, JoJo might need to sing too!

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran S3 Ep5
programme.desc: Gran Gran's keys get stuck behind the sofa. Inspired by inventors from the past, JoJo and Gran Gran invent a 'key collector' to get them back!

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran S3 Ep7
programme.desc: JoJo and Gran Gran have fun finding Gran Gran's old clothes. When Charlene brings round a sewing machine, it's time for a Gran Gran plan - they can make JoJo some new clothes too!

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran S3 Ep13
programme.desc: JoJo and her cousin Lexi are learning how to swim underwater - but it's a little bit tricky. It's time for a Gran Gran plan.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran S3 Ep15
programme.desc: JoJo's excited to go on her first camping trip with Gran Gran, Cousin Lexi and Uncle Tyrell. It'll be JoJo's first time sleeping outside, and there's lots to find out about camping.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran S3 Ep26
programme.desc: When JoJo and Gran Gran pick up Lexi from school, JoJo wants to learn everything about Lexi's day. It's time for a Gran Gran plan - why don't they play schools together?

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran S3 Ep32
programme.desc: Gran Gran has a sleepover plan. Instead of reading a bedtime story, JoJo and Gran Gran go stargazing. What can they spot in the night sky? And can Great-Gran Gran see the same stars?

programme.title: Kazoops! S1 Ep22
programme.desc: Monty is in a topsy-turvy mood and doing things a little bit differently, leaving him questioning why things always have to be same.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran S2 Ep31
programme.desc: JoJo, Gran Gran, Ezra and Jaxon are all set for a day of sledging in the snow, but when the sledge breaks, Gran Gran comes up with a plan so that they all can keep having fun in the snow!

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran S2 Ep30
programme.desc: When Mummy's at work, JoJo asks what a job is. While Gran Gran explains, they realise Mummy accidentally took Gran Gran's phone! Now JoJo's job is visiting Mummy to fix the mix-up!

programme.title: Sarah and Duck S2 Ep2
programme.desc: After getting muddy, Umbrella has to brave his fear of getting wet and take his first bath!

programme.title: Sarah and Duck S2 Ep3
programme.desc: A search for shade on a hot day leads Sarah and Duck to discover a fascinating tower in the park.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends S24 Ep6
programme.desc: There's a fancy dress competition on the railways and while Thomas and the others are excited, Shankar doesn't want to join in.

programme.title: Bluey S1 Ep43
programme.desc: While on a camping holiday, Bluey makes a new friend named called Jean-Luc. Bluey may not understand him, but they find a common language playing and hunting for a wild Daddy pig.

programme.title: Bluey S1 Ep44
programme.desc: Bingo and Bluey have five minutes to bed, just enough time to race to the summit of Mount Mumandad. But for them, facing powerful storms, avalanches and stinky spots will take teamwork.

programme.title: Bluey S1 Ep45
programme.desc: A quick trip to the shops proves tricky for Dad, when Bingo and Bluey want to play a game of 'Kids'. Now Bluey is Mum, Bingo's her baby and for Dad however, he is a very naughty boy.

programme.title: Supertato S2 Ep8
programme.desc: Supertato and Tomato find themselves stuck in a slippery bathtub, whilst Evil Pea rampages around the supermarket on a giant soap-squirting machine.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S2 Ep19
programme.desc: Duggee and the squirrels take a boat down the river to deliver a package.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S2 Ep20
programme.desc: The squirrels are full of energy so Duggee calms them down with some Yoga!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S2 Ep21
programme.desc: The squirrels are busy making collections of their favourite things.

programme.title: Go Jetters S3 Ep44
programme.desc: Lars zooms to the rescue when Glitch and Tala go off the rails in search of a baby dragon.
